verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party rules engine where a user defines event-to-action rules that run automatically. Webhooks (call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed) only push events to your own server, so any rule logic must be built by the developer. That makes them a building block, not the capability itself. Function calling is invoked by the agent's model mid-conversation, and per-agent data retention is a fixed deletion policy; both are adjacent features, not user-defined event-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
